Every TryCatch overload must wrap and preserve unclassified exceptions.

Back to STXEX rulesRead The Standard source

What The Standard says

Every TryCatch overload must wrap and preserve unclassified exceptions. The analyser reports this as a warning at the declaration or statement that needs attention.

Why it matters

This rule belongs to the Exception handling family. Following it keeps responsibilities and intent visible to readers, tooling and future maintainers.

Bad code example

// Violates STXEX003: Every TryCatch overload must wrap and preserve unclassified exceptions.
catch (Exception exception) { throw new Exception(message); }

Good code example

// Follows STXEX003
catch (Exception exception)
{
    throw new StudentServiceException(message, exception);
}
